verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Mastra's observability system gives visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction, plus a Studio UI at localhost:4111 for inspecting traces/runs. This directly matches the story of tracing LLM calls and tool invocations in an observability UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the tracing UI in practice and more detail on trace granularity or export/integration with external observability backends.
